def factor_vol_asymmetry_vol_regime(df):
    """Volatility asymmetry of intraday returns amplified by volume regime ratio."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    intraday_ret = df_copy["close"] / df_copy["open"] - 1.0
    up_vol = np.power(intraday_ret.clip(lower=0), 2)
    down_vol = np.power(intraday_ret.clip(upper=0), 2)
    asym = up_vol.ewm(span=20, min_periods=20).mean() - down_vol.ewm(span=20, min_periods=20).mean()
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    df_copy["factor_vol_asymmetry_vol_regime"] = asym * vol_ratio
    return df_copy["factor_vol_asymmetry_vol_regime"]
description: Mutation of volatility asymmetry × volume ratio. Preserves the core directional pressure mechanism: the difference between exponentially weighted squared upside and downside intraday returns. Replaces the ad-hoc volume ratio (volume/rolling20mean smoothed by EWM3) with the standardized CogAlpha volume regime module vol_ratio, which measures short-term volume intensity against EMA20. This simplifies the volume scaling, reduces overfitting, and leverages a reusable module for consistent volume amplification, aiming to improve RankICIR while preserving the raw volatility asymmetry signal.
